title: Unable to discard Omnipod Dash pod after error
symptom: After a pod error, the user removed the pod and broke its PCB. When trying to replace it, the app went through the deactivation sequence without delays, but the option to discard the pod never appeared, even after multiple failed disconnects. Another user reports the same problem: cannot release old pod, deactivate does not work and just finishes with no results.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but the issue reporter suggests that the app does not register failed disconnection attempts as such, preventing the discard button from becoming visible.
fix: The issue reporter manually adjusted the code to make the discard button visible in the state they were in, and provided a patch. A maintainer later committed a fix and asked to test again, but the thread does not describe the exact fix.
evidence_quote: So, I guess that in this case the app doesn't register the failed disconnection attempts as such. Eventually I manually adjusted the code to make sure the discard button becomes visible in the state I was in
